verdict.rationale: Clerky's own pricing docs say it lets users complete IRS forms and submit them to the IRS online, in-house and without a fax. That is the platform's own IRS filing service, which plausibly covers EIN applications, but the evidence never names the EIN or the SS-4. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that EIN (Form SS-4) applications are included, details on EIN issuance and delivery, and independent or hands-on corroboration of founders getting an EIN through Clerky.

support.subject: As a founder, I can obtain a federal EIN for my new company through the platform

citations.quote: Use Clerky to complete IRS forms and submit them to the IRS, completely online. No need for a fax machine. 100% in-house, not outsourced.
